lean.reason: A prose book review (Journal of the American Statistical Association 115:529, printed pp. 482-485, PDF pp. 2-5) with no theorem, formula, identity, bound or proof on any rendered page: its eight headline claims (P050-H1 to P050-H8) are interpretive remarks tied to no numbered result, and its only two confirmed errors, both Minor (P050-E001, the word 'out' missing from 'Pearl is quick to point the first part while neglecting the second', p. 484, PDF p. 4; P050-N006, the closing re-quotation 'finding a solution [to confounding]', p. 485, PDF p. 5, against 'finding that solution', p. 483, PDF p. 3), are a wording misprint and a quotation slip with no mathematical statement to correct.
